name: pg_window_possible_crash_during
goal:
A WindowAgg node with a run condition may stop evaluating window functions for the rest of a partition once the condition turns false. On the topmost WindowAgg node a later row can then be projected carrying window function results that were computed for an earlier row.

Where such a result is of a by-reference type the memory behind it may be gone already, and the backend can crash.

It takes all three of: a run condition, a PARTITION BY clause, and a window function in the same node returning a by-reference type, such as lead() or lag() over a text column.

Every row projected has to carry values belonging to that row. Queries with no run condition must be unaffected.
